description: Implementation of a mutable builder class for creating responses and events related to modifying feature definitions in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides factory methods for various response types such as creation, modification, and error responses, as well as event generation. The class is part of the command handling mechanism for live feature definition modifications.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of a builder for creating command responses and event objects related to feature definition modifications, encapsulating the response and event creation logic.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new builder instance for a specified command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse object by applying the provided function to the internal ResponseFactory.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an Event object by applying the provided function to the internal EventFactory.
